ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) field with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white/grey) distribution concentrated in linear and circular surface disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base layer of uniform black (RGB ~20,20,20). Overlaid with high-contrast white linear vectors (scratches) primarily on the left lobe. Discrete high-intensity circular rings (rosettes) distributed across both lobes. Significant white/grey contiguous patch at the extreme right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 45 degrees and a bounding box depth approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge. Multiple non-uniform indentations (peaks and valleys) with amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels. Notable deep notch on the inner-right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex lower margin with trailing edges exhibiting an upward concave sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed circular white ring-like clusters (barnacle scars) appearing as high-contrast circles against the black field, concentrated in the central-mid regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark field; primary cluster on the left lobe consists of multiple intersecting diagonal vectors.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring across the entire visible surface including numerous rake marks and circular barnacle attachment scars; notable irregular white lesion or pigment anomaly at the far right distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense and complex pattern of overlapping circular scar rings creating a unique textural signature across the mid-to-lower portion of the fluke lobes.
